verdict.rationale: Edge0 has several programmatic surfaces: an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server, a Python AutoEngine/AutoModel API, and a CLI with flags for model selection, adapters, prerouter and output length. It also ships desktop and mobile apps, but nothing in the evidence says those apps' features are all reachable through the API, so UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of app features (e.g., model download and management or adapter switching over HTTP), and API reference docs or independent corroboration.
